key_icons: A flat black keypad in four rows with white labels, the columns separated by short white dividers, each digit with its small letters to its right. The 1 key shows a small voicemail symbol (two small rings joined along their bottoms); the 5 key has a small dot at its left; the * key also shows '+' and a small key-lock symbol; the 0 key also shows a space symbol; the # key also shows a/A and a small silent (crossed note) symbol.
keypad_labels: 2 ABC, 3 DEF, 4 GHI, 5 JKL, 6 MNO, 7 PQRS, 8 TUV, 9 WXYZ
